extraction.runWrapperReason: This sandbox denies renaming a directory once a spawned subprocess (ffmpeg, used only by prepare) has written into it, even though copy+delete of the same tree succeeds. The wrapper calls the skill's unmodified prepare()/export() functions directly and finishes their publish step with copy+delete instead of the blocked rename; it does not change extraction logic, masking, or validation.
